Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: How do you actually oust anyone with this deck? Or keep from being ousted yourself for that matter, rock cats are kind of expensive, and you have very little pool gain and no defense.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> Klaital wrote:
> How do you actually oust anyone with this deck? Or keep from being ousted yourself for that matter, rock cats are kind of expensive, and you have very little pool gain and no defense.
>
I suppose the defense is the tupdogs, which can block once each. Of course, a single Bonding would be enough to get through.

Messages.Author: Jussi
Messages.Body:
Tupdogs are sabbat, so you could add Yawp Court for protection from politics.

Second fame would enhance your ousting, and I'd be tempted to add a lucky Leadership Vacuum.

Perhaps a token !Tremere, so tupdogs can act as bleeders when you don't need protected resources anymore (or rushers for that matter).

And since you have allies, Unmasking and FBI events would enhance your pool protection slightly. ... oh, forget about Unmasking, just read last item in the deck

----
Banging trashcans, breaking windows
We'll wake you up tonight

We like the good time, we scream and shout
And that's what fun's about

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Defense is Rock Cat + Unmasking. Tupdogs are only there to bring the Cats in play.

This deck could use a Wider View or two.

And some way to deal with a Secure Haven on someone. A second Fame could help with the ousting. I don't like the Anarch Revolts - they'll burn them, and it cost you 3 MPAs.
Graverobbing is a nice option that I would consider.
